description: This file contains utility functions and data for text generation, including random string, name, and post generation, as well as embedded test data for markdown, emojis, and URLs, used within the Mattermost project.

methods.name: RandString
methods.description: Generates a random string of specified length from a given charset.

methods.name: SecureRandString
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random string of specified length.

methods.name: RandIntFromRange
methods.description: Returns a random integer within a specified range.

methods.name: FuzzName
methods.description: Returns a fuzzed team name string from predefined list.

methods.name: FuzzPost
methods.description: Returns a fuzzed post content string from predefined list.

methods.name: RandomText
methods.description: Generates a random text snippet with optional hashtags and mentions.
